_about: The papers the Control Room's Papers page shows. Made by tools/legal/make-legal-pdfs.py; the Control Room reads this file and each PDF from this repository's main branch.

papers.title: Adding a New Customer
papers.about: Your steps, from saying hello at their lot to their first quote: the sign-up link, the photos, their Dealer Center, their computer, their other lots and the monthly fee.

papers.title: Welcome Sheet
papers.about: Give it to the owner when you set up their computer: signing in, putting it on their computer and phone, prices, lots, team, their website and help.

papers.title: Terms and Conditions
papers.about: What every owner agrees to on their sign-up page. They also tick I agree in their Dealer Center the first time they sign in.

papers.title: Flyer
papers.about: Hand it out or email it to shed companies. It shows the 3D designer, what they get and the price, with your email and web page.

papers.title: Price Sheet
papers.about: What it costs: no setup fee, $250 a month with the first lot included, $250 one time for each lot after the first, with examples and how to start.

papers.title: Setup Questions
papers.about: Only if you can't visit them: they answer it and send it back with photos of their buildings, price list and options.
